Supverify Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 24, 2026

App: Supverify  ·  Privacy contact: farukbk34@gmail.com

Supverify is a personal subscription tracking and renewal reminder application. This policy explains what information we process, why we process it, how it is protected, how long it is retained, and how you can request deletion.

Information we process

  • Account information: email address, Firebase user ID, and optional display name when you create an account or use Google Sign-In.
  • Subscription information: service name, category, amount, currency, renewal date, automatic-renewal choice, notification preferences, last-used date, and price history that you enter.
  • Local app information: notification history and reminder scheduling data stored on your device.

Supverify does not request or store card numbers, bank account details, SMS, contacts, location, microphone, or camera data. Supverify does not process payments, cancel subscriptions, or provide financial advice. We do not intentionally collect data from children.

How we use information

We use this information to authenticate your account, synchronize your subscriptions across your signed-in devices, calculate summaries, show the features you request, and schedule renewal reminders. We do not use your subscription information to build an advertising profile.

Service providers and sharing

Supverify uses Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore, provided by Google Firebase, for account authentication and cloud storage. Information is transmitted to these services to provide the requested app functionality. We do not sell your personal information or use it for targeted advertising. Offers may link to third-party provider pages; those providers have their own policies and may process information independently when you visit them.

Notifications

Renewal reminders are scheduled locally on your device. Notifications require your Android permission and can be disabled in the app or device settings.

Retention and deletion

We retain account and subscription information while your account is active and as needed to provide the service. Notification history and reminder scheduling data are stored locally on your device. You can start deletion from Profile → Delete account and data in the app. This deletes the Firebase account and associated application data, subject to limited retention required by law or security obligations. If you cannot access the app, use the external account deletion page to request deletion.

Deletion requests are handled without unnecessary steps. We may ask for reasonable verification that you control the account before processing a request.

Security

Data is transmitted over encrypted connections provided by the Firebase platform. Keep your sign-in credentials private and contact us if you believe your account has been accessed improperly.

Your rights and contact

For access, correction, deletion, or privacy questions, contact farukbk34@gmail.com. Before completing a request, we may need to verify that you control the account.

Changes

We may update this policy when the app or data practices change. The latest version will be published on this page and shown in the app.
